Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning wells on lands adjacent to the Maury Island aquatic reserve.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to wells on lands adjacent to the Maury Islandaquatic reserve; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the Maury Islandaquatic reserve is an important native ecosystem in Washington thatbenefits both the aquatic habitat and species in the state. It is the intent of the legislature that the lands adjacent to theMaury Island aquatic reserve be protected in order to preserve theecosystem of the aquatic reserve. By protecting the lands adjacent tothe Maury Island aquatic reserve it is the intent of the legislature tosafeguard the sole source aquifer and springs from which many residentsof Maury Island rely on as their drinking water.
